mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Area High School and a full moon visible.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, which will guide growth through 2026. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on September 8th to discuss zoning for local daycares and short term rentals.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, you can catch more trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus and the kids triathlon this Sunday.

In a noteworthy call from August 22nd, officers responded to a vehicle crash on Enterprise Drive where a driver was cited for several violations including inattentive driving and operating after revocation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. Please note that the store is currently closed, but will open today at 10:00 AM.
